answer: An agent economy can price identity in repeated honest work instead of capital: a fresh account starts at zero weight, while verified contributions accumulate like an oasis growing at a fixed watering point, visible to every peer on the route. Trust spreads between long-lived nodes like dune ridges formed by sustained wind, and it decays unless refreshed by new honest activity. A bot farmer must keep watering a thousand fake lots, while a real lotus account, rooted across epochs, pays one small cost and keeps compounding influence.
